display_fil:
Pagkatapos ng baha, itinatala ng BHW ang alalahanin
at naghahatid ng impormasyon sa response team.
Aktibo pa ba ang lumang BHERT roster?
display_en:
After flooding, the BHW records concerns
and relays information to a response team.
Is the old BHERT roster still active?
narration_fil: Pagkatapos ng pagbaha, hinihiling sa BHW na itala ang mga alalahanin at maghatid ng impormasyon sa response team. Hindi malinaw kung aktibo ang lumang BHERT roster.
narration_en: After flooding, a BHW is asked to record concerns and relay information to a response team. It is unclear whether an old BHERT roster is active.

narration_fil: Kumpirmahin sa barangay at health supervisor ang kasalukuyang team, tungkulin, lider at reporting channel. Iulat ang minimum na kailangan: lugar, panganib, agarang pangangailangan, ginawa at susunod na contact. Mag-handover at itala ang oras; panatilihing pribado ang sensitibong detalye.
narration_en: Confirm the current team, role, lead and reporting channel with the barangay and health supervisor. Report the minimum needed: location, hazard, urgent need, action taken and next contact. Hand over and record time; protect sensitive details.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Maaaring nagbago na ang response team. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: The response team may have changed. What do you do first?

options.fil: Tawagan ang nakalistang lead sa lumang roster.
options.en: Call the person listed as lead on the old roster.

options.fil: Kumpirmahin ang kasalukuyang lider at channel, saka mag-handover.
options.en: Confirm current lead and channel, then hand over.

options.fil: Ipadala sa lahat ng nasa lumang listahan ang pangalan at sakit ng residente.
options.en: Send the resident's name and illness to everyone on the old list.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring hindi na siya ang lead; kumpirmahin muna. 2: Kapag kumpirmado ang team at channel, makararating ang pangangailangan sa may pananagutan. 3: Maaaring luma ang listahan, at dapat pribado ang pangalan at detalye ng kalusugan.
check.feedback_en: 1: That person may no longer be the lead; confirm first. 2: A confirmed team and channel mean the need reaches someone responsible. 3: The list may be old, and names and health details must stay private.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Huwag ipalagay na aktibo ang BHERT.
Kumpirmahin ang kasalukuyang focal person.
Mag-handover sa tamang channel.
display_en:
Do not assume an active BHERT.
Verify the current response focal person.
Hand over through the approved channel.
narration_fil: Hindi ipinagpalagay ng BHW na may aktibong BHERT. Kinumpirma niya ang kasalukuyang response focal person at ipinasa ang pangangailangan sa tamang channel.
narration_en: The BHW does not assume an active BHERT. They verify the current response focal person and hand the need over through the approved channel.

display_fil:
Hindi team ngayon ang lumang BHERT slide.
Walang klinikal o enforcement na papel.
Panatilihing pribado ang sensitibong detalye.
display_en:
The old BHERT slide is not today's team.
No clinical or enforcement duties.
Protect sensitive details.
narration_fil: Ang lumang pandemic-era BHERT slide ay hindi patunay ng kasalukuyang team composition, isolation o contact-tracing mandate. Huwag magtalaga ng klinikal o enforcement na papel sa BHW.
narration_en: The old pandemic-era BHERT slide does not establish today’s team composition, isolation or contact-tracing mandate. Do not assign clinical or enforcement duties to a BHW.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Kumpirmado na ang kasalukuyang lead. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: You have confirmed the current lead. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Gamitin ang lumang roster at ipalagay ang dating mandato.
options.en: Use an old roster and assume its former mandate.

options.fil: Iulat ang lugar, pangangailangan at ginawa; itala ang oras.
options.en: Report location, need and action taken; record the time.

options.fil: Mag-handover nang hindi inaalam kung natanggap ito ng team.
options.en: Hand over without checking that the lead or team received it.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: hindi lumang roster ang batayan ng team ngayon. 2: Sa maikling handover na may oras, masusundan ang pangangailangan. 3: Kung walang pagtanggap, walang nakaaalam kung natanggap ang pangangailangan.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: an old roster does not set today's team. 2: A short handover with the time recorded keeps the need traceable. 3: Without acknowledgement, no one knows the need was received.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

display_fil:
Sa Lunes: ipa-update sa supervisor ang
role-and-handover card: posisyon, backup,
channel at petsa ng kumpirmasyon.
display_en:
On Monday: the supervisor updates the
role-and-handover card: position, backup,
channel and verification date.
narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ipa-update sa supervisor ang role-and-handover card: pangalan ng posisyon, alternatibong contact, channel at petsa ng kumpirmasyon.
narration_en: On Monday, ask the supervisor to update a role-and-handover card: position, backup contact, channel and verification date.
